status: Credible future algorithm hypothesis, not admitted or claimed better
mechanism: History-only adaptive probabilistic-mixture weights emphasizing relevant regimes or recency, with any forgetting/smoothing learned through chronological prequential validation rather than a fixed decay
motivation: Current pool estimates one set of mixture weights from equally averaged historical nonoverlapping target-horizon forecasts. Regime changes may make relevance time-dependent. Initial richer pooling improves provisional development whereas hard selection loses; no conclusion about later validation.
source_scope: CRPS learning supports online/adaptive forecast combination; its quantile-wise method is not copied blindly because coherent joint asset-path distributions must be retained.
requirements: Only origin outcomes already realized within outer training history may train weighting or tune adaptation
No outer panel scores or ticker-specific routing
Learn a whole joint-path component mixture, not independently rearranged asset/quantile paths
No arbitrary rolling-history/origin caps or automatic prior-winner fallback
Reuse per-fold coefficient sufficient statistics without materializing unbounded history x options-squared caches
Support and uncertainty must be disclosed for only-two-block long-horizon validation; do not call it stable by assumption
Test unchanged single main score on exact same successful cases before any promotion
why_not_speculative_by_default: Different selection infrastructure/temporal weighting mechanism not previously tested here; evidence review and qualification needed before numerical admission
